contents.name: Corollary 14.3
contents.reason: This corollary identifies the zero-weight multiplicities of the adjoint-finite bimodule U_chi. That structural Harish-Chandra-bimodule statement belongs with the maximal-quotient and primitive-ideal package, not the center-only page RL-1.

contents.name: Corollary 14.4
contents.reason: Tensoring a finite-dimensional bimodule with U_chi stays inside the Harish-Chandra-bimodule world. RL-1 has no bimodule theory yet, so this consequence is intentionally reserved for the later primitive-ideal page.

contents.name: Corollary 14.5
contents.reason: The quotient description of adjoint-finite bimodules is a classification statement about Harish-Chandra bimodules. It depends on the maximal-quotient construction and is therefore routed to the later primitive-ideals page rather than RL-1.
